A '''corporation''' operated in around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]]. They discovered a cure to the deadly [[C5H4 virus]] but refused to release it to the public. A diplomat met with the corporation to negotiate the cure's purchase so they could release it.<ref name="TCM">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|A Cure for What Ails You}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The corporation was first mentioned as part of the Diplomacy Crew Skill mission "A Cure for What Ails You" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
